verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a state business-registry and e-filing service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only web-based filing, annual reports, payments and status lookups, with no mention of an MCP server, API or agent connectivity. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
